commit.message: Attestation copy is mode-aware: simulated records never claim on-chain anchoring
Showcase writes never impersonate Coston2 txs: tagged hashes, simulated badges, mode-aware feed copy
Surface honest mode: meta.showcase flag, UI mode banner, hosted-demo links, KYB roadmap wording

Round 4 polish: supplierWallet in prefetch + full pre-fee validation; Actions v5

- SorFacts now carries the normalized supplier payment address; before any
  FDC fee is spent the document must have a valid payout wallet, matching
  invoice number, documentSha256 and debtor tag, and the intake form must
  agree on amount and due date
- Post-attestation cross-check extended to supplierWallet (checksummed
  comparison) — strict mode underwrites the same supplier-system facts FDC
  later proves, payout wallet included
- CI: actions/checkout@v5 + actions/setup-node@v5, permissions contents:read
  (clears the runner Node 20 deprecation warnings)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Review round 3: strict mode underwrites attested facts; docs + CI hygiene

- Strict mode now PRE-FETCHES the system-of-record document: the LLM scores
  the document's facts (not the intake form), mismatched or missing documents
  reject before any attestation fee, and after attestation ALL facts
  (invoiceNumber, amount, dueTs, documentSha256, debtorTag) are cross-checked
  against the reviewed document. Decision memos record underwritten.from.
- Proven live on the demo hub with enforcement on: INV-2026-0043 underwritten
  from the Pages document, attested in round 1385898, registered via Merkle
  proof, FTSOv2-funded, settled in FXRP (combined strict+interop evidence).
- README: scraper-proof placeholders ({number}.json, {sha256-hex}), real
  headers on summary tables, settlement-headroom disclosure (overpayment
  accrues to LPs, stated in InvoiceSettled), new combined-evidence row.
- SECURITY: settlement headroom note.
- ci.yml: pure ASCII job names, Node 22 (removes deprecation warnings).
  Repo-wide scan for hidden/bidi Unicode: zero occurrences (raw README is
  231 lines; the "single line" reports were a fetch-tool artifact).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Strict e2e uses unconsumed ERP docs (0040/0043); 0042 stays the fdc:register showcase doc

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Contract v2: FTSOv2 freshness guard + attested supplier binding + two-address posture

- maxFeedAgeSeconds (default 1h, admin-set, evented): funding, settlement
  quoting and reserve valuation revert on stale feed values (StaleRate)
- InvoiceFacts gains supplierWallet: while fdcEnforced, advances are paid to
  the ATTESTED payout wallet from the system of record — a compromised agent
  key cannot redirect them (UntrustedSource if the document binds none)
- ERP documents + Web2Json jq/abiSignature carry supplier.paymentAddress
- Two-address posture: FAKTURA_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT (permanently strict) vs
  FAKTURA_CONTRACT (demo hub); strict runs route to the evidence hub
  automatically, and demo mode hard-refuses to touch it (server + e2e guards)
- deploy.ts reuses FAKTURA_FXRP so both hubs share one settlement token
- 14 hardhat tests passing (adds attested-wallet binding + staleness suites)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Address judge-readiness review: real strict FDC path, on-chain risk policy, FXRP settlement leg

P0 (credibility):
- contracts/scripts/registerViaFdc.ts + agent strict mode: full Web2Json flow
  (verifier prepareRequest -> FdcHub -> voting-round finalization -> DA-layer
  Merkle proof -> on-chain verifyWeb2Json); executed live on Coston2
  (round 1385814) with register/fund/settle txs linked in README
- .env.example rewritten Flare-native; Casper config removed everywhere
- npm scripts fixed: agents e2e/capture:seed exist and run; dead seed removed
- honest provenance wording: Casper prototype -> ground-up Flare port
- redeployed + explorer-verified FakturaHub 0xe7Fb9db0...cc58 and DemoFXRP;

P1 (depth):
- on-chain RiskPolicy (max risk, discount band, tenor cap, per-invoice
  exposure cap) enforced in registerInvoice/fundInvoice; erpUrlPrefix pins
  FDC-attested facts to the supplier system of record (UntrustedSource)
- FXRP settlement leg: settleInvoiceInToken priced by the XRP/USD FTSOv2
  feed; token reserve marked to market inside poolValue
- ERP system of record: docs/erp/*.json served via GitHub Pages (Web2Json

- decision memos persisted byte-exact, served at GET /api/memos/:hash;
  committed sample matches the on-chain decisionHash
- x402 copy converged to "x402-inspired, Flare-native settlement"

P2: CI workflow (contracts tests / agents typecheck / web build),
SECURITY.md trust-boundary table, docs/judges.md 3-minute path,
docs/why-flare.md

Found while proving the path end to end: GitHub raw serves text/plain and is
rejected by the Web2Json verifier (moved source to Pages); ethers v6 frozen
decode Results cannot be passed back into contract calls; FTSOv2 read gas
variance caused intermittent out-of-gas (30% headroom on all writes).
12 hardhat tests passing.
